A student reviews the required environmental evidence and must explain the first clear pattern. Which answer uses the lesson evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, Read the population graph or table. Then use the required stimulus (Carrying-capacity graph/model) to connect the visible evidence to population structure, population change, and carrying capacity. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.ENV.POP.02 and avoids the common mistake: thinking population size changes for one reason only.

answer.text: population changes through births, deaths, immigration, emigration, resources, and limiting factors. In this item, the evidence from Carrying-capacity graph/model should be used to explain population structure, population change, and carrying capacity.
